parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Switches on or off the power of the LED.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The internal name used to identify this LED.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The textual purpose that represents the visual display of the LED (e.g., Broadband Down).

parameters.name: CyclePeriodRepetitions
parameters.description: The number of cycle periods left for this LED. As each cycle period is completed this parameter is reduced by 1. A value of -1 indicates an infinite number of cycle period repetitions.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: The location of the LED as the user looks at the front of the device in its typical orientation (e.g., on-end, flat).

parameters.name: RelativeXPosition
parameters.description: The relative x position of the LED from left to right (x) and top to bottom (y) as the user looks at the device from the orientation identified in the {{param|Location}} parameter in its typical orientation (e.g., on-end, flat).

parameters.name: RelativeYPosition
parameters.description: The relative y position of the LED from left to right (x) and top to bottom (y) as the user looks at the device from the orientation identified in the {{param|Location}} parameter in its typical orientation (e.g., on-end, flat).

parameters.name: MaxBrightness
parameters.description: The maximum allowed brightness level for the LED. This value is determined by the hardware capabilities.

object.description: Each instance of this object describes an LED on the device. The default illumination characteristics (e.g., Color, Brightness) of an in use LED is vendor specific. When a cycle completes (i.e., {{param|CyclePeriodRepetitions}} = 0), the LED reverts back to its default illumination characteristics. When the value of the {{param|Status}} parameter is {{enum|Controlled|Status}}, then the value of {{param|CycleElementNumberOfEntries}} and {{param|CycleElementNumberOfEntries}} parameters SHOULD be 0. When the value of the {{param|RelativeXPosition}} and {{param|RelativeYPosition}} parameters are 0, this indicates that the position of the LED is unknown.
